fullPassage: Exercising right after you eat will cause feelings of discomfort. But, if you wait too long to exercise after eating, you'll suffer from a lack of energy. The best time to eat before you exercise varies from one to three hours. Basically, it depends on several factors such as the type and amount of food as well as body size, age, and gender. The type of exercise also matters. For extremely active exercise like cycling, I suggest that you wait between one and a half and three hours after eating a moderate-sized meal. But for something more casual, such as golfing, waiting for one hour after a meal should be enough.

questions.passage: Well, as I said before, exercising right after you eat will cause feelings of discomfort. But, if you wait too long to exercise after eating, you'll suffer from a lack of energy.

다음 [조건]과 [보기]를 참고하여, 주어진 우리말을 영작하시오.

[조건]
· 아래 보기의 단어를 모두 사용하고, 필요시 형태를 변형할 것
· 한 문장으로 작성할 것

[보기] exercise / right / eat / cause / discomfort

[우리말] 식사 직후에 운동하는 것은 불편함을 야기할 것이다.

det.korean: 식사 직후에 운동하는 것은 불편한 느낌을 야기할 것이다. 동명사 주어(Exercising) + right after(직후에) + will cause(야기할 것이다) + feelings of discomfort(불편함) 구조입니다.
det.analysis: 원문: Exercising right after you eat will cause feelings of discomfort.
det.tip: 서술형 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: When you eat, blood rushes to the digestive system to help break down the food and absorb its nutrients. But when you start to exercise, blood moves from the digestive system to your muscles.
questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

"When you eat, blood rushes to the digestive system to help break down the food and (absorption) its nutrients."

det.korean: 음식을 분해하고 영양분을 흡수하도록 돕기 위해. help + (to) + 동사원형 구조에서 break down과 병렬로 absorb(동사원형)가 와야 합니다.
det.analysis: 원문: to help break down the food and absorb its nutrients
det.tip: 서술형 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.
